blocks.text: Dear Harvest Partner, A sudden change is coming to the world financial systems. At the present time the SWIFT system, which is located in Belgium, controls all electronic financial trades. Recently an order was given to the SWIFT system to eliminate Iran from being able to buy or sell through that electronic system. Rev. 13:17, “and that no man may buy or sell.” Next we are going to a new system that is being created called the European Stabilization Mechanism Treaty. This is the new European Union and the euro. It will be in place and operative by July 2012. It will control all of the money in the European Union. It cannot be challenged, changed or sued, or got rid of. Due to the enormous debts it will have absolute power. – Here is an amazing quote from Special Writing #51. “Some of the controls we see today foreshadow some kind of strict measures in the future! The anti-Christ system will control water, food and transportation. Of course all of the controls will lead into an intended trap, complete government control of world economy and the loss of all economic and political freedom!” – I will do more research on this and will write about it in another letter. Now we have another quote from Brother Neal Frisby’s library.

Oh my, what a marvelous, astonishing and wonderful era to be living in! We used to see the roots of apostasy coming, but now it’s grown into a full cup of iniquity, abomination and falseness! – “And yet right in the midst of this, God is doing an amazing harvest work among His believers! He is bringing restoration and a great outpouring among the elect!” We are seeing both sides of the coin, the good will become closer to God, and the evil will worsen! – Some people may think that they have a lot of time, but the harvest soon will be over with. The midnight cry is here. “Be ye also ready!” Jesus said, “In an hour that ye think not,” Matt. 24:44. Like a flash of lightning, in a moment, in a twinkling of an eye, millions will have vanished into another dimension! Caught up in the translation! – May we add this, those believers in the graves will be included in this group too! Praise the Lord! – “Divine wisdom, knowledge and power will begin to cover His elective group uniting them in His glory, divine love and word!” – “Be ye therefore careful, and not careless as the world, but be watching and praying! For as a snare shall it come! And the world will be off guard in that momentous moment! Like a flash of light the elect body will be with Me in a beautiful prepared place!” – Note: Praise Him again! With all the test and trials that His children have to go through it will be worth it all! What splendor and glory lies just ahead for those who believe these anointed words! Yes, and what a generation we are abiding in! “Startling and tremendous signs and prophecy are taking place daily all over the earth!” Some things that the Scripts predicted decades ago are now taking place right in front of our eyes! “Some Bible prophecies given 2 and 3 thousand years ago are also occurring like a giant sign post right in front of us and the world!” – Evidently it is hidden from the world and lukewarm churches! The way they are acting you would think that they had forever to wait on the Lord. “But this is just exactly the way that the Scriptures said it would be!” And I definitely believe that the Scripts gave us some real information concerning some different seasons and events between now and Armageddon! Sorcery, witchcraft, voodoo and satanic worship will be springing forth like a wild fire blazing in every direction bringing forth falseness! New cults are springing up on every corner! The New Age Groups are also growing and spreading. – “So warn your children, and pray for our youth!” Because the sun is beginning to go down on this generation! Time is short. – Remember that “the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy!” And the foretelling of events will alert, unite and guide His elect! So as you witness, tell the people that Jesus is returning soon! Look at this sign! – Israel is blossoming forth like a rose. Soon the Lord will pick His chosen rose! (Rev. 7:4) But the bride will have just left. (Rev. 12:5) – “Oh what a happy and rejoicing time to be living in!” – Let us take advantage of it!

A notorious henchman under a religious guise will soon appear! Outwardly his manner will be peaceful, but he will be as good as any Hollywood actor who ever was! Underneath lurks a desolator! – In the midst of the Tribulation shall come a satanic prince out of the bottomless pit that is made right for his character; then the deception (astonishing) change! From then on a murderous, diabolical madman who will control the earth as a sinister dictator! – Israel will fit right in this New World system! And is related in Dan. 9:27, where it projects the prince of the Revived Roman Empire and makes his covenant with the Jews to restore their Old Testament type worship. (sacrifice, etc.) – This is the hour of vigilance and urgency! Harvest work is speeding up; let us pray for the last souls that are coming in! For it says, “immediately He putteth in the sickle, for harvest is ripe and is ending with a flash of power!” End quote. This month I am releasing a Special Writing called “The Spirit of Prophecy” as well as a DVD called “Prophetic Waves.” (See offer below) – This has been a timely letter that will fit in with our projects. Here is an update. We now have a French book of Special Writings as well as in Dutch and Polish. They have been a great blessing for people to read Brother Frisby’s vital message and your help has made all of this possible! Your continued support will help publish these books. Jesus’ wonderful blessings will be with you and His wisdom will guide you as we complete the task.

All three new CD’s/Cassettes, $15.00 donation: New DVD release: “Prophetic Waves” “Nature Prophesying” Also available: “Time” “Believe That You Receive” ($20.00 donation each) “Healing – Mind, Soul And Body”
